# TPC-Havoc Q17_v2

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH avg_qty AS (
  SELECT
    l_partkey,
    0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS threshold
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY
    l_partkey
)
SELECT
  SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem, part, avg_qty
WHERE
  p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey
  AND p_brand = 'Brand#23'
  AND p_container = 'MED BOX'
  AND avg_qty.l_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey
  AND l_quantity < avg_qty.threshold
```
